documentedBreaches.title: Bound gzip inventory expansion before allocation
documentedBreaches.standard: AGENTS.md engineering principles4 and5: validate untrusted external inputs at boundaries and bound resource use.
documentedBreaches.reason: gzip.decompress allocates the entire expanded inventory before the 32 MiB check; the 8 MiB compressed ceiling in verify_q cannot bound expanded memory, and the hash check follows decompression.
documentedBreaches.requestedChange: Use a bounded gzip stream read of (32<<20)+1, reject overflow before JSON decoding, and preserve exact compressed hash validation.
documentedBreaches.scope: Portable retention verifiers only; unchanged runtime source maps remain applicable.
